# .github/scripts/coverage-floor.py: a module below its floor, or a module without a line here, fails
# the job.
#   c   <module> <floor %> <files>   line coverage (llvm-cov) of coretest's tests: the coverage job of windows.yml
#   go  <package> <floor %>          statement coverage (go test -coverprofile) of the Linux jobs of
#                                    controller.yml and ranz-bgp.yml
# A floor is the coverage measured in CI when it was recorded, rounded down to a whole percent, less
# two points for the tests whose paths depend on timing. Raise a floor when a module gains tests; a
# change that lowers one says why in its pull request.
